title: Jujutsu Kaisen Studio Just Dropped A Trailer For Their New 2027 Anime, & It’s Stunning
content: Anime fans haven’t even begun to sink their teeth into Fall 2026’s impeccable seasonal line-up and studios are already beginning to tease what’s in store for the Winter 2027 season.

title: Bleach’s Final Season Confirms New Release Date for Anime’s Final Episode Ever
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War has announced a surprise hiatus before the anime returns for its final two episodes, and with it has confirmed a new release date for the anime’s final episode ever.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll Just Revealed a New Look at 2027’s Most Viral Anime Yet
content: There’s no denying that anime of all genres has hit the mainstream hard in the last few years, and with seasonal anime circuits only growing in popularity, fans are anxiously awaiting to see what the next big thing they need to add to their calendar will be.
author: ComicBook

title: BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!! x BanG Dream! Our Notes Reveals Story Link Trailer
content: BanG Dream! It’s MyGO!!!!! and BanG Dream! Our Notes revealed a story link trailer on Saturday. The video teases the story of MyGO!!!!! continues in Our Notes . Story link trailers for Ave Mujica and Mugendai MewType (Yumemita) were also previously released. MyGO!!!!! is a band from BanG Dream!
author: Anime Corner

title: '#Zombie Sagashitemasu' Unveils Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, First Promo
content: The special livestream presentation for the television anime adaptation of Katsuwo 's #Zombie Sagashitemasu ( #I'm Looking for Zombie ) manga unveiled additional cast, staff, a key visual (pictured right), the theme songs, and first promotional video on Sunday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Seventh Ending Featuring "Ameato" by W-inds
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its sixth ending, featuring the song “Ameato” by W-inds. The song was used in Episodes 77-89, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner

title: #I'm Looking For Zombie Anime's Main Trailer Reveals More Cast & Staff Members, Theme Songs, October 3 Debut
content: Kadokawa revealed on Sunday the main promotional video, main visual, additional cast and staff members, theme song artists, and October 3 debut for the television anime of Katsuwo 's #I'm Looking For Zombie ( #Zombie Sagashitemasu ) manga.
author: ANN

title: Overgeared Anime Reveals Third Trailer and Key Visual, Adds Yuki Murata and Yurika Hirayama to Cast
content: Overgeared anime revealed its third trailer and third key visual ahead of its October 2, 2026 premiere date. Two additional cast members were also announced, while the trailer previews the ending theme “Ray of Emotion.” The second PV and visual were revealed in July during Anime Expo.
author: Anime Corner

title: Overgeared Anime Reveals 3rd Trailer, 2 New Cast Members
content: The official website for Tempal: Item no Chikara (Tempal ~The Power of Items~), the television anime of South Korean webtoon studio REDICE STUDIO 's Overgeared webtoon, started streaming the anime's third trailer, and revealed the third key visual, and two more cast members, on Sunday.
author: ANN
